factories.name: newSearchTicketsStep
factories.description: Search one page of Zoho Desk tickets by status, status type, priority, contact email, department, and modified time, with from and limit paging of at most 100 tickets.

inputSchema.description: SearchTicketsInput selects tickets with typed filters that the connector turns into Zoho Desk search parameters. Different filters narrow each other; several statuses, status types, or priorities match any of them. At least one filter is required.

contactEmail.description: ContactEmail keeps only tickets whose email or contact email is this address, compared without regard to letter case, such as jane@example.com. Zoho Desk's email filter also matches look-alike addresses, so the connector checks each ticket itself; a page can then hold fewer tickets than Limit, even none, while NextFrom is set. Blank keeps every contact.

departmentId.description: DepartmentID matches tickets in this department. Blank searches every department the agent can see.

from.description: From is the zero-based index of the first result, 0 to 4999.

limit.description: Limit is 1 to MaxSearchLimit; zero uses DefaultSearchLimit. A page that would pass result MaxSearchResults is shortened to end there.

modifiedSince.description: ModifiedSince matches tickets modified at or after this RFC 3339 instant with an explicit offset, such as 2026-01-21T00:00:00Z, until the time of the request. Blank applies no time filter.

priorities.description: Priorities matches tickets with any of these Zoho Desk priority names, such as High.

statusTypes.description: StatusTypes matches tickets whose status falls under any of these types, so custom statuses match without listing them. Set Statuses or StatusTypes, not both.

statuses.description: Statuses matches tickets in any of these Zoho Desk status names, including custom statuses, such as Open or Waiting for Customer. Set Statuses or StatusTypes, not both.

factories.name: newGetTicketStep
factories.description: Read one ticket by ID with its contact and bounded lists of its newest threads and newest comments.

inputSchema.description: GetTicketInput names one ticket and how many of its newest threads and comments to return.

commentLimit.description: CommentLimit is 1 to MaxCommentLimit; zero uses DefaultCommentLimit.

threadLimit.description: ThreadLimit is 1 to MaxThreadLimit; zero uses DefaultThreadLimit.

ticketId.description: TicketID is the Zoho Desk ticket ID, a decimal string such as 1892000000042034.

factories.name: newCreateTicketStep
factories.description: Create one ticket in a department for a contact. Zoho Desk has no idempotency key, so the Step runs with sync durability and sends the request at most once per Step execution.

TicketContactInput.description: TicketContactInput identifies a ticket's contact by email for createTicket.

email.description: Email is one bare address such as jane@example.com.

firstName.description: FirstName names a contact Zoho Desk adds; blank sends none.

lastName.description: LastName names a contact Zoho Desk adds; blank sends none.

inputSchema.description: CreateTicketInput is one new ticket in a department. Zero values leave a field to Zoho Desk's defaults, the department's layout, and its automations.

assigneeId.description: AssigneeID assigns the ticket to an agent, or empty for Zoho Desk's routing.

contact.description: Contact identifies the customer by email. Zoho Desk uses the contact with that address or, when none exists, adds one with the given names.

contactId.description: ContactID names an existing contact. Set ContactID or Contact.Email, not both.

departmentId.description: DepartmentID is the department that owns the ticket. Zoho Desk requires it; GET /api/v1/departments lists the organization's departments.

description.description: Description is the ticket's plain-text content, at most 65,535 characters. It is required. The connector escapes it into Zoho Desk's HTML description, so markup is shown literally and line breaks are kept.

priority.description: Priority is a Zoho Desk priority name, or empty for the department's default.

status.description: Status is a Zoho Desk status name, including custom statuses, or empty for the department's default.

subject.description: Subject is the ticket subject, at most 255 characters. It is required.

factories.name: newUpdateTicketStep
factories.description: Set the status, priority, assignee, or department of one ticket; a repeated attempt finds the change already applied and writes nothing.

inputSchema.description: UpdateTicketInput is one change to an existing ticket. Empty fields are left unchanged; this release cannot clear an assignee.

assigneeId.description: AssigneeID assigns an agent of the ticket's department, or empty to keep the assignee.

departmentId.description: DepartmentID moves the ticket to another department, or empty to keep it. Zoho Desk applies the new department's rules, so set AssigneeID too when the agent must stay assigned.

priority.description: Priority is the new Zoho Desk priority name, or empty to keep it.

status.description: Status is the new Zoho Desk status name, including a custom one, or empty to keep it.

ticketId.description: TicketID is the Zoho Desk ticket ID.

factories.name: newAddCommentStep
factories.description: Add one public or private plain-text comment to a ticket. Zoho Desk has no idempotency key, so the Step runs with sync durability and sends the request at most once per Step execution.

inputSchema.description: AddCommentInput is one plain-text comment to add to a ticket.

content.description: Content is the plain-text comment, at most MaxCommentRunes characters. It is required. The connector sends it as plainText, so markup is shown literally.

isPublic.description: IsPublic adds a public comment, which the customer can see in the help center. False adds a private comment that only agents see. Zoho Desk fixes visibility when the comment is added.

ticketId.description: TicketID is the Zoho Desk ticket ID.
